tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' spyod dmar mo'i 'pho ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ye/ 'pho ba'i dbang la/ mdun bskyed gzhal yas khang gi nang du chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bskyed/ slob ma seng khri'i steng du bde mchog tu bskyed/ ye shes dbab/ dngos gzhi la mkha' spyod ma mar me gnyis mched kyis tshul du mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ dbang bzhi la ḍā dril dang oṃ gsum ma/ 'pho ba'i khyad par gyi byin rlabs la mdun bskyed kyi rnal 'byor ma byon/ slob ma bde mchog tu gsal ba'i dpung pa gnyis kyi steng du zhabs bzhag gsang gnas padma dmar po kha phye ba lta bu tshangs bug dang sprad pa'i rnam par gsal btab/ lte bar rang sems a dkar po 'phur la khad pa rgod kyi tho thung lta bu dang rlung gi yom yom bskyod bzhin pa des gyen du bltas pas/ tshangs bug skya ha re ba de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang gnas mthong / der 'gro ba'i 'dun pa drag pos/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid du gsol/ lan gsum thugs kha nas 'od zer dkar po ba thag brkyangs pa lta bu nar gyis byon/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lte ba'i a la reg pas khab len la lcags 'jus pa ltar 'then nas lus kyi dbus na yar ye re re song / tshangs bug nas thon/ bha ga nas zhugs/ thugs khar slebs pa tsam la tog sgra dang bcas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nam mkha' la yed kyi byon/ blos 'khyud tshad du byon pa dang dag pa mkha' spyod du phebs par bsam/ rnal 'byor ma 'ja' yal ba ltar bsam la rig pa brjod med du 'jog ḍā dril rol chen oṃ gsum ma/ yang nam mkha' la sprin rdol ba bzhin rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lam gyis byon/ mar babs dpung pa'i steng du zhabs bzhag pa'i thugs kha nas rang sems a mched lte bar slebs/ yang gsol 'debs sogs gong bzhin re dril bas tshar gsum mdzad/

mthar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas thim pas spyi bo sra shing mkhregs pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam/ rjes 'gre'o/ /'di mkha' spyod dkar mo'i 'pho ba rje btsun grol mchog gis mdzad pa de'i rjes la bri rgyu yin// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 rje btsun grol mchog mkha' spyod dmar mo'i 'pho ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
